newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends five cents higher at 15.18 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends five cents higher at 15.18 rgt.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended five cents higher at 15.18 ringgit ($6.08) a kg because of the steadiness in London and overseas buying.
Traders said that the market saw buying from Europe and Malaysia. Turnover was 156 tonnes against 128 tonnes on Wednesday.
The Malaysian price was now at par with the London market, after being at a discount of $15 a tonne previously, they said.
The market is seen steady amid concerns over the stock level in London warehouse, the traders said.
